import json, tempfile, yaml
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.appforge_design import compile_appforge_design
from factoryline.mcp import mcp_status
from factoryline.revenue_evidence import FAILURE_SCENARIOS, evaluate_failure_matrix, promote_evidence_memory, query_evidence_memory, replay_purchase_journey, sync_testflight_evidence, watch_policy_drift
from factoryline.webmcp import webmcp_manifest
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    def write_json(name, value):
        path = root / name; path.write_text(json.dumps(value), encoding='utf-8'); return path
    manifest = {'app': {'name': 'Example', 'bundle_id': 'com.example.app'}, 'products': [{'id': 'com.example.pro.monthly', 'display_name': 'Pro', 'type': 'auto_renewable', 'duration': 'P1M', 'group': 'pro', 'entitlements': ['pro']}], 'paywall': {'value_before_price': True, 'price_and_duration_before_cta': True, 'single_primary_cta': True, 'restore_purchases': True, 'patterns': []}, 'legal': {'privacy_policy_url': 'https://example.com/privacy', 'terms_url': 'https://example.com/terms'}, 'privacy': {'purchase_history_linked': True, 'purpose': 'app_functionality'}}
    products = root / 'products.yaml'; products.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(manifest), encoding='utf-8')
    kinds = ['paywall_presented','purchase_started','transaction_verified','server_notification_verified','entitlement_active','app_restarted','entitlement_restored']
    events = [{'id': f'e{i}', 'sequence': i, 'type': kind, 'product_id': 'com.example.pro.monthly', 'verified': True, 'entitlement': 'pro'} for i, kind in enumerate(kinds, 1)]
    replay = replay_purchase_journey(root, products, write_json('events.json', {'build': {'id': '42', 'bundle_id': 'com.example.app', 'environment': 'testflight'}, 'events': events}), Path('.factory/revenueforge/example/replay.json'))
    inbox = sync_testflight_evidence(root, write_json('feedback.json', {'items': [{'id': 'f1', 'build_id': '42', 'kind': 'feedback', 'summary': 'Restore worked'}]}), Path('.factory/revenueforge/example/testflight-inbox.json'))
    matrix = evaluate_failure_matrix(root, products, write_json('matrix.json', {'scenarios': {name: {'observed': True, 'passed': True, 'evidence_ref': name} for name in FAILURE_SCENARIOS}}), Path('.factory/revenueforge/example/failure-matrix.json'))
    source = {'id': 'review', 'url': 'https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/', 'sha256': 'a' * 64, 'retrieved_at': '2026-08-29T00:00:00Z', 'impacts': [{'rule_id': '3.1.1', 'apps': ['com.example.app'], 'artifacts': ['paywall']}]}
    drift = watch_policy_drift(root, write_json('policy-base.json', {'sources': [source]}), write_json('policy-now.json', {'sources': [source]}), Path('.factory/revenueforge/example/policy-drift.json'))
    entry = {'app_id': 'com.example.app', 'journey': 'purchase', 'decision': 'keep', 'resolution': 'verified lifecycle', 'approved_by': 'Reviewer', 'expires_at': '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'evidence_receipts': ['.factory/revenueforge/example/replay.json']}
    memory = promote_evidence_memory(root, write_json('memory-entry.json', entry), Path('.factory/revenueforge/memory/purchase.json'))
    recalled = query_evidence_memory(root, 'com.example.app', 'purchase', '2026-08-29T00:00:00Z')
    brief = {'app_name': 'Example', 'audience': 'teams', 'primary_job': 'understand access', 'desired_emotion': 'calm control', 'screens': [{'id': 'home', 'user_goal': 'see access'}]}
    design = compile_appforge_design(root, write_json('brief.json', brief), Path('.factory/appforge/design'))
    mcp = mcp_status(root); web = webmcp_manifest()
    assert replay['verdict'] == 'matched' and inbox['marker'] == 'REVENUEFORGE_TESTFLIGHT_EVIDENCE_SYNCED' and matrix['verdict'] == 'pass'
    assert drift['verdict'] == 'current' and memory['marker'] == 'REVENUEFORGE_EVIDENCE_MEMORY_PROMOTED' and recalled['status'] == 'available'
    assert design['marker'] == 'APPFORGE_DESIGN_WORKSPACE_WRITTEN' and 'factory.appforge_status' in mcp['tools']
    assert len(web['tools']) == 4 and all(tool['annotations']['readOnlyHint'] for tool in web['tools'])
print('REVENUEFORGE_EVIDENCE_V2_SMOKE_PASS')
